description.p: Footy records from your microphone, transcribes the speech on your computer and hands you the text. Silence is skipped, and past transcripts stay in the app's history.
A speech model is downloaded on first use. Audio is transcribed locally. Text is only sent to another service if you set up optional post-processing.

In the Flatpak, global shortcuts and automatic paste use your desktop's permission prompts, and what is available depends on the desktop. Footy can also be started and stopped with its command line options, which any desktop shortcut editor can run.
